build_optimizer_with_scheduler: build an AdamW optimizer with a cosine learning rate scheduler for a PyTorch model
build_lr_fn_cosine: build a cosine learning rate function with warmup and configurable cycle length
build_lr_fn_wsd: build a warmup-stable-decay learning rate function based on the river valley loss landscape paper
create_OptimArgs_dataclass: create an OptimArgs dataclass to configure optimizer hyperparameters like lr, weight decay, and scheduler type
test_lr_linear: test the linear learning rate schedule function with warmup and minimum ratio parameters
